notes.claim: Droop is the percentage change in speed that takes the governor through its full action.
With 5 percent droop, full-load speed is 100 percent and no-load speed is 105 percent.
A load step the engine cannot supply at once reduces the engine speed, which is a frequency dip.

sources.title: Droop speed control - Wikipedia — en.wikipedia.org
sources.quote: Droop is therefore expressed as the percentage change in (design) speed required for 100% governor action.

sources.title: Droop speed control - Wikipedia — en.wikipedia.org
sources.quote: By definition, with 5% droop the full-load speed is 100% and the no-load speed is 105%.

sources.title: WHITE PAPER — generac.com
sources.quote: Frequency dip is when the engine cannot supply enough power (kW) to support the load demand, causing a reduction in engine RPM.
